scope: EP8 network dispatch and return both GIN; same-NUMA P2P unchanged; EP4 localP2P unchanged
dependencies: NVSHMEM3.8 remains for symmetric allocation and existing localP2P implementation; not a removal of NVSHMEM dependency
platform: Validated NIC map is physical GPU0..7 on .16; MEGAMOE_GIN_HCA_MAP explicitly overrides
lifecycle: One tester/session per isolated distributed worker process; no error-triggered backend fallback
startup: Empty receiver epoch0, initialized epoch1, assert only ordinary count fields zero; signal polls use GIN API
protocol: Fused return payload/strong commit; local GIN flush plus application receive/cyclic ACK/terminal credit joins; no remote marker/get
timing: FullK3 output-ready latency; terminal credits are joined before next reset but may extend past timed end event

build.device: clang++ --cuda-device-only --cuda-gpu-arch=sm_90 -emit-llvm -O2 -std=gnu++17 with pinned CUDA12.8 headers and NCCL2.32.3; source and BC checksums pinned together

signal_consumers: NIC VA signals use ncclGin waitSignal/readSignal acquire API, including owner counts/routes and packed return chunk index; ordinary P2P/ACK/data fields retain prior access methods
completion: Local GIN flush only for source retirement; original application receive commit/ACK/terminal credit dependency proves remote consumption and reuse. Not a generic remote-quiet implementation.
host_progress: Poll all dependent Green-context events before blocking end synchronization or native validation
ready_metadata: Return probe acquires metadata epoch and reloads concurrent threshold with volatile/cache-volatile access every retry
